projects.title: Autonomous Disaster Relief Swarm Drone Navigation
projects.description: Decentralized vision-based SLAM and edge computing mesh network enabling micro-drones to survey collapse zones without GPS.
projects.abstract: In disaster scenarios where GPS signals are jammed or degraded indoors, search and rescue robots must localize and map subterranean collapsed rubble autonomously. This project introduces a cooperative decentralized visual-inertial SLAM algorithm deployed on NVIDIA Jetson Orin micro-drones, sharing sparse 3D point clouds over an ad-hoc 5.8GHz peer-to-peer radio mesh.
keySpecifications: 120 fps onboard stereo SLAM
Sub-centimeter obstacle avoidance
Peer-to-peer ad-hoc mesh up to 500m
Auto-return upon 15% battery reserve

documentation.overview: Autonomous disaster relief swarm drone navigation system designed for subterranean and GPS-denied environments.
documentation.methodology: Utilized ROS2 Humble on Ubuntu 22.04 LTS coupled with custom PX4 flight controllers. Onboard stereo cameras feed a dual-pass EKF fusing IMU and visual odometry.
documentation.results: Demonstrated 99.4% autonomous navigation success across 25 simulated collapse courses, mapping a 1,200 sq. meter zone in under 4.2 minutes.
documentation.futureWork: Thermal imaging integration for body heat signature detection through smoke.
documentation.billOfMaterials: Carbon-fiber custom frames, Jetson Orin Nano, PX4 Pixhawk 6C, Intel RealSense D435i, 6S 4500mAh LiPo.

projects.title: Bionic Myoelectric Prosthetic Hand with Tactile Feedback
projects.description: Low-cost 3D printed prosthetic arm with embedded pressure sensors returning haptic feedback to residual limb nerves.
projects.abstract: Modern commercial myoelectric prosthetics cost upwards of $30,000 and lack closed-loop sensory feedback. This capstone presents an open-source, sub-$450 prosthetic hand with 6 degrees of freedom driven by micro linear servos and closed-loop piezo-resistive fingertip pressure sensing translated to non-invasive vibrational nerve stimulators on the residual forearm.
keySpecifications: 6 Degrees of Freedom with individual finger articulation
< 65ms latency from EMG muscle burst to grip closure
Continuous closed-loop 256-level haptic feedback
Battery endurance > 18 hours per charge

documentation.overview: Closed-loop biomimetic prosthetic terminal device incorporating active cutaneous feedback.
documentation.methodology: Multi-channel dry surface EMG electrodes record muscular voltage fluctuations from residual forearm muscles. Real-time neural network classifier distinguishes 14 distinct grip postures.
documentation.results: Amputee test subjects achieved 94.8% grip classification accuracy, successfully picking fragile objects like raw eggs without breakage.
documentation.futureWork: Direct osseointegration mechanical coupling and wireless telemetry diagnostics.
documentation.billOfMaterials: PETG 3D structural bones, TPU flexible joints, Coreless micro-servos, ESP32-S3 microcontroller, Linear resonant haptic actuators.

projects.title: Zero-Knowledge Decentralized Academic Credential Ledger
projects.description: Tamper-proof verifiable diplomas using cryptographic ZK-SNARK proofs that respect student privacy while enabling instantaneous verification.
projects.abstract: Degree fraud costs institutions and employers billions annually while background check companies invade student privacy by demanding raw transcripts. We designed a cryptographic credentials protocol where university registrars sign degrees as Merkle leaves. Students can prove graduation date, GPA threshold, and major using zero-knowledge proofs without revealing their full transcripts or personal identities.
keySpecifications: Proof generation latency < 1.2s on mobile client
Verification gas cost < 185,000 on EVM L2
Zero student PII revealed during employment check
W3C Verifiable Credential standard compliant

documentation.overview: Privacy-preserving decentralized academic verification engine utilizing Groth16 zk-SNARK circuits.
documentation.methodology: Designed arithmetic circuits in Circom verifying ECDSA registrar signatures inside the zk-proof. Smart contracts deployed on Layer-2 blockchain verify proofs in O(1) time complexity.
documentation.results: Tested with 10,000 synthetic campus diploma issuances. Zero cryptographic leakage of student personal information.
documentation.futureWork: Integration with national digital identity frameworks and decentralized storage pinning.
documentation.billOfMaterials: Cloud verifier nodes, EVM RPC endpoints, OpenZeppelin cryptographic contracts.

projects.title: AgriSense: Autonomous Solar AI Rover for Precision Agriculture
projects.description: Solar-powered autonomous agricultural rover with multispectral computer vision for real-time crop disease diagnosis and targeted non-chemical weed eradication.
projects.abstract: Excessive herbicide use causes environmental degradation while manual crop scouting is labor-intensive. AgriSense is an autonomous solar rover navigating furrow rows with RTK centimeter-precision GPS and multispectral cameras to identify foliar blights, nitrogen deficiencies, and target weeds with high-precision mechanical cutters.
keySpecifications: Centimeter-accurate RTK-GPS navigation
97.2% weed identification accuracy at 1.5 m/s
100% solar self-recharging with 300W bifacial panel
LoRaWAN farm telemetry uplink up to 10 km

documentation.overview: Self-sustaining agricultural rover combining precision robotics with edge AI plant pathology models.
documentation.methodology: Trained custom YOLOv8-Nano models on over 80,000 multi-spectral crop leaf images. Integrated rocker-bogie suspension for uneven farm terrain traversal.
documentation.results: Reduced farm herbicide consumption by 91% on test wheat and soy plots.
documentation.futureWork: Automated nighttime UV-C fungal spore sterilization modules.
documentation.billOfMaterials: Aluminum extrusion chassis, All-terrain rocker-bogie, Jetson Nano, RTK GNSS module, 100W brushless hub motors.

projects.title: NeuroScan: Ultra-Low-Power Wearable EEG for Seizure Pre-Detection
projects.description: Ultra-low power wearable headband acquiring 8-channel EEG signals with transformer-based edge AI to forecast epileptic seizures up to 15 minutes before onset.
projects.abstract: Epileptic patients suffer unexpected seizures that result in physical injury and loss of independence. NeuroScan is a lightweight, non-invasive forehead headband with dry conductive polymer electrodes streaming EEG data into an ultra-low-power TinyML transformer model that detects pre-ictal bio-electrical rhythms 8 to 15 minutes prior to seizure manifestation.
keySpecifications: 8-channel 24-bit bio-potential resolution
Seizure onset anticipation window: 8 - 15 minutes
Power consumption < 12mW for 48-hour continuous runtime
Automatic emergency SMS + GPS location alert to caregivers

documentation.overview: Wearable neurological monitoring system for real-time pre-ictal seizure prediction.
documentation.methodology: Designed low-noise active electrodes and implemented a quantized 1D temporal convolutional transformer on dual-core ARM Cortex-M33.
documentation.results: Achieved 96.2% sensitivity with a false positive rate under 0.04 per hour on CHB-MIT clinical benchmark datasets.
documentation.futureWork: Closed-loop vagus nerve micro-stimulation for active seizure abort.
documentation.billOfMaterials: Flexible polyimide PCB, TI ADS1299 analog front end, Nordic nRF5340, Medical-grade silicone enclosure, 300mAh LiPo.

projects.title: EcoDrive: Liquid-Cooled Solid-State Battery for Formula Student EV
projects.description: High-density 400V solid-state battery accumulator with microchannel phase-change cold plates and real-time CAN bus telemetry for collegiate electric formula racing.
projects.abstract: Collegiate electric racing mandates extreme power density under rigorous safety constraints. EcoDrive engineers an experimental 400V, 6.8 kWh solid-state pouch-cell battery pack with 3D printed additive cold plates circulating dielectric fluid, delivering 80kW peak power with uniform pack thermal variance under 2.3°C during endurance sprint laps.
keySpecifications: 400V nominal bus with 80kW peak output
Microchannel cold plate cooling maintaining cells < 38°C
Total accumulator weight only 42 kg (190 Wh/kg pack-level)
Dual redundant optical isolation safety interlocks

documentation.overview: Next-generation solid-state battery energy storage system for Formula Student competition.
documentation.methodology: Conducted computational fluid dynamics (CFD) in ANSYS Fluent to model laminar coolant flow over cell terminals. Programmed custom STM32 BMS monitoring 96 individual cell voltages at 1 kHz.
documentation.results: Vehicle completed 22 km endurance race without thermal throttling, achieving 0-100 km/h acceleration in 3.1 seconds.
documentation.futureWork: Regenerative braking optimization and carbon-fiber composite casing integration.
documentation.billOfMaterials: Custom cell modules, Copper nickel-plated busbars, STM32-H7 master BMS, Dielectric coolant pump, Carbon fiber flameproof box.

projects.title: HoloTutor: Augmented Reality Spatial Anatomy & Engine Simulator
projects.description: Cross-platform WebXR spatial learning environment enabling multi-user holographic disassembly of turbofan jet engines and human cardiovascular systems.
projects.abstract: Traditional CAD models and 2D diagrams fail to convey complex spatial physics in engineering and medical education. HoloTutor runs directly in web browsers supporting Apple Vision Pro, Meta Quest, and mobile phones, enabling synchronous multi-student virtual dissection of intricate 3D assemblies with zero software installation.
keySpecifications: Sub-16ms latency for 90 fps spatial rendering
Multi-user shared room synchronization via WebRTC
Physical hand tracking gesture manipulation
Zero-install runs directly in Safari & Chrome WebXR

documentation.overview: Browser-based spatial computing educational platform with real-time multi-user physics.
documentation.methodology: Developed GLTF model compression pipelines reducing 2M polygon jet engines to under 12MB. Engineered custom spatial anchor sync over WebRTC DataChannels.
documentation.results: Classroom trials with 120 students showed 44% higher retention rates on mechanical anatomy exams compared to textbook study.
documentation.futureWork: Haptic force-feedback glove integration and AI voice tutor avatar.
documentation.billOfMaterials: WebXR headsets, WebRTC signaling servers, AWS S3 model CDN.

projects.title: CyberSentinel: AI Deception HoneyNet for Automated Zero-Day Defense
projects.description: Dynamic generative honeynet creating synthetic campus servers and decoy SCADA infrastructure to lure, trap, and reverse-engineer zero-day cyber attacks in real-time.
projects.abstract: Critical university networks and energy grids face automated nation-state scanning. CyberSentinel deploys lightweight containerized honeypots that dynamically mimic real campus database servers and building automation controllers. When breached, an LLM-driven decoy simulates realistic shell sessions to keep adversaries engaged while eBPF kernel hooks record malware binaries and payloads.
keySpecifications: eBPF low-overhead kernel syscall recording
Dynamic realistic response generation using local LLM
Automated extraction of indicators of compromise (IOCs)
Zero false-positive alarms to campus SOC

documentation.overview: Autonomous cyber deception platform isolating advanced persistent threats.
documentation.methodology: Kernel-level probes trace file descriptors, network sockets, and execve calls inside unprivileged container jails. Payloads are automatically detonated in air-gapped sandboxes.
documentation.results: Intercepted 1,420 real malicious intrusions over 30 days without exposing production campus databases.
documentation.futureWork: Automated firewall rule synthesis and threat intel sharing via STIX/TAXII.
documentation.billOfMaterials: Kubernetes edge cluster, eBPF Linux kernel nodes, Elasticsearch SIEM.

projects.title: SkyNet CubeSat: 1U Nanosatellite with LoRa Earth Mesh Telemetry
projects.description: University 1U CubeSat payload engineered for low Earth orbit, carrying a wide-angle Earth observation sensor and amateur radio LoRa ground relay transponder.
projects.abstract: Access to space telemetry remains expensive for educational institutions. SkyNet CubeSat is a 10x10x10cm nanosatellite featuring triple-junction GaAs solar arrays, a dual-redundant FreeRTOS on-board computer, and long-range LoRa modulation capable of transmitting telemetry directly to low-cost $20 handheld ground stations worldwide.
keySpecifications: 1U Form Factor (10 x 10 x 10 cm, 1.18 kg mass)
433MHz LoRa downlink receivable by handheld dipole antennas
Passive magnetic stabilization with hysteresis rods
Space-grade vacuum and thermal cycled (-20°C to +70°C)

documentation.overview: Collegiate orbital nanosatellite platform enabling open scientific access.
documentation.methodology: Designed 6-layer high-reliability PCB backplane complying with CubeSat Design Specification (CDS) standards. Conducted shake table vibration and thermal vacuum chamber tests.
documentation.results: Passed all pre-flight thermal-vacuum (TVAC) and launch provider vibration screening protocols.
documentation.futureWork: Orbital launch scheduled aboard commercial rideshare rocket in Q3 2027.
documentation.billOfMaterials: Space-grade aluminum 6061 chassis, GaAs triple-junction solar panels, STM32-L4 ultra-low power MCU, Semtech SX1262 transceiver.
